issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases, such as missing configuration files or invalid task definitions.

scenarios.name: setup-mono-repo-tasks
scenarios.rationale: Response A satisfies almost all rubric requirements except the missing package.json details, while Response B fails on several key points such as the schema URL, task structure, env placement, and lint task.

scenarios.name: run-filtered-build
scenarios.rationale: Both responses omit the required --dry=json flag, so neither meets the rubric.

scenarios.name: docker-prune-buildfile
scenarios.rationale: Response B correctly implements the multi-stage Dockerfile with node:24-slim, turbo prune, out/json and out/full handling, and build steps, but omits the .dockerignore mention; Response A fails on base image, file copying, and .dockerignore.
